term.label: altered_gene_product_sequence

definition.text: A sequence variant that alters the sequence of a gene product.

comments: Added as per request from Ang Roberts as part of GenCC November 2020. See Issue Request #501 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/501)
